findings.motion: Co-sponsor (listed among additional sponsors, not primary) of HB 1246, Safeguarding Elections Act
findings.note: She is listed as a co-sponsor of HB 1246. The bill text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H1246v1.pdf) would make it a misdemeanor for any person to demand citizenship documentation from a voter other than what State law requires at any point during the voting process. It also makes photographs for voter photo identification and photocopies of identification confidential records. Referred to House Rules committee 2026-08-04.
